findings.title: Deploy button hardcodes a specific GitHub account/repo
findings.desc: The "Deploy with Vercel" URL hardcodes `repository-url=...aditya-adiga%2Fmeta-formalism-copilot`; if the canonical repo is renamed, transferred, or this doc is reused by a fork/downstream org, the button will silently point at the wrong source and break the "self-hosted, run your own copy" flow described in CLAUDE.md.
